text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"—Things keep changing. Me, and everyone 
around me. 
For every dream, new paths branch out... 
and pull us apart..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"We get more rivals, too. Some might even 
have to retire halfway through... 
When that day comes, I wonder if we'll 
still be able to stay the way we are—"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Haaaah....... I can't sleep... 
I think I'll go get some fresh air..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Haaaaah~~~ I'm such an idiot... 
Why now? This was always bound to happen 
anyway."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"We're not grade schoolers anymore. 
Everyone's got their own path, their own 
world to build. 
...Dia-chan looked so pretty in her 
kimono, too. Almost like a completely 
different person..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"(What if I wake up tomorrow morning... 
and Dia-chan's already grown up into an 
adult without me...?)"
...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"All that's left are paper cups, and... 
the Satono group is getting the disposable 
chopsticks, so~... 
Kita-san, could you show me the shopping 
list one more time?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Kita-san... are you alright? 
Um, is something... on your mind?"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Ah...! Y-Yes! The list, right?! 
Uh, let's see, where did I put it..."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...Shall we take a little detour, you 
two? 
After this, all we have to do is drop 
everything off at the shrine and head 
back."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"............ 
I-It's so delicious when you drink it on a 
cold day like this...!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, it's a flavor you can truly 
appreciate only with the changing of the 
seasons. 
Having little moments like this makes you 
feel that change isn't so bad, doesn't 
it?"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"............ 
Grass-san... what do you mean by that...?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"~~~! U-Um, you see! Actually, last night 
I saw you outside from my window, 
and, well... I was worried, so I talked to 
Grass-chan about it..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"A-Aaahh~~~! That was, uh... 
You saw me, huh... How pathetic of me."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan... would you mind telling us 
what's on your mind?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"I may not look it, but I am your senior, 
and it worries me to see a lovely junior 
looking so downcast."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh... Um, it's really not that big of a 
deal, but... 
Well, it seems like... I'm 'scared'—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan... is taking a while...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —I see, so that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone changes bit by bit without even 
realizing it, right? 
It's always been that way. Both for 
myself, and for everyone else..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"And yet, I suddenly got terrified 
thinking about how much will change 
once we become adults... Ahaha, pretty 
silly, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"No, not at all. I can certainly relate to 
those feelings. 
Spe-chan and I had our fair share of 
struggles back then too, after all."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, me too... Even though excitement 
usually wins out, 
it's not like I don't feel any anxiety 
about the future at all."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Even our seniors felt that way...? 
Really?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Even if we share the same starting 
line, our paths will inevitably diverge. 
Because everyone has their own goals they 
are striving toward..."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"There will be times when you can no 
longer win, and times when your rivals 
leave you far behind. 
There are even moments when you feel as 
though you've been left all alone..."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Yet, what is truly important never 
changes. You simply keep running along the 
path you believe in... 
And along the way, as I kept running, my 
dream gradually reshaped itself."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu, wasn't it the same for the Uma-Miko 
Shrine Visit? 
We must change to move forward. And yet, 
the core foundation remains unshaken."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah... now that you mention it...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"As long as you treasure what is truly 
important, nothing will ever be lost. 
So please, do not be afraid of change."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"If you do that, I'm sure a wonderful 
future will be waiting for you. 
In racing, and in life... wouldn't you 
say?"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see... Even if things change, nothing is 
lost...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I want to keep being her precious friend, 
and her greatest rival... 
That feeling alone surely—no, definitely 
will never change...!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much, both of you...! 
I'm... going to go see Dia-chan right 
now!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, okay! Have fun~! 
...Ehehe, looks like she's going to be 
just fine, right?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Yes... Fufu, it really brings back 
memories... 
We, and all our classmates, had times like 
that as well, didn't we?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Eh? D-Did we really~...? 
Maybe we did... Ehehe..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah, a LANE message from Kita-chan...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What's this? "Where are you right now?" 
Hmph, really...? 
I'm on the roof-top...! Sent!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—Why is the reply from Sweep-san, of all 
people—?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're late, Kitasan! Where on earth have 
you been?! 
Satono was waiting at the school gate for 
you the entire time!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Wah! You promised to keep that a secret! 
It was my own choice to wait, after all...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan... 
U-Um, you see! There's something I need to 
tell you...!
